sentences.text: 1 4 . It transpires from the order dated 22.12.2021 that the applicant was released on interim bail subject to deposit of sum of Rs. 1 lac in the form of demand draft/banker's cheque drawn in favour of the informant on or before 15th April, 2022.
There is nothing on record to indicate that applicant ever deposited the said amount or surrendered before the Court concerned.
It appears that the applicant is enjoying the fruits of interim bail granted to him by this Court.

By the order dated 22.12.2021, the second bail application was again listed for 18.04.2022 for final consideration of bail and since then, none has appeared on behalf of the applicant to press the instant second application for bail.
5. According to the F.I.R., applicant is the main culprit who impersonated Avinash and cheated the informant.
First bail application of the applicant has already been rejected.
There is no fresh ground for allowing the second bail application.
6. In the facts and circumstances as above, applicant is not entitled to be enlarged on bail, second bail application of the applicant is accordingly rejected.
7. Let the order be sent to the trial court concerned for taking necessary coercive action against the present applicant.

(Renu Agarwal,J.) Order Date :- 16.1.2024 Karan  Prithvi Singh Second Bail vs State Of U.P. on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93170346/
